title: Qordic Technologies overview
content: Qordic Technologies provides software delivery and operational support for businesses. Its published website describes a business-first approach focused on practical software, clearer operations, and better decision-making. The company discusses scope and next steps with each prospective client. Published website: /about.

title: Qordic Technologies services
content: The website lists these service areas: Real Estate Software; ERP Systems; Custom Software; Mobile Applications; AI Chatbots; Websites & Portals; Outsourcing & BPO Support; and Maintenance & Ongoing Support. Services are scoped around the client's needs, business processes, and requirements. Published website: /services.

title: Real estate software
content: Qordic Technologies describes real estate software for property-focused workflows. Examples on the website include lead and customer records, property and unit information, progress visibility, and connecting property, inventory, customer relationships, and transaction workflows. The exact scope depends on the client's requirements. Published website: /services.

title: ERP systems
content: Qordic Technologies describes ERP systems as a way to coordinate operational processes and business information. Published examples include process mapping; modules such as finance, inventory, procurement, human resources, or sales when appropriate; and planning data, permissions, and reporting around organizational needs. Published website: /services.

title: Custom software, websites, and mobile applications
content: Qordic Technologies offers custom software such as web platforms, internal tools, and workflow applications; websites and digital portals; and mobile experiences for customers or staff. The website says mobile experiences may be planned in relation to web services and data. Specific technologies, scope, and delivery plans should be confirmed with the team. Published website: /services.

title: AI chatbots and automation
content: Qordic Technologies lists AI chatbots and workflow automation among its service areas. The website describes conversational tools for customer questions, internal knowledge access, or other defined use cases, and suggests identifying repetitive handoffs to see where software can reduce manual steps. Published website: /services.

title: Outsourcing and ongoing support
content: Qordic Technologies discusses outsourcing and BPO support for defined business tasks, with clear responsibilities and handoffs. Maintenance and ongoing support can be discussed based on software needs, coverage, and communication requirements. Availability and exact terms must be confirmed with the team. Published website: /services.

title: Project process
content: The published process has five stages: Discover (map the challenge, goals, users, and constraints); Design (align on product direction, scope, and user journey); Develop (build in focused phases with visible progress and timely feedback); Deploy (prepare, test, launch, and hand off); and Support (maintain and improve systems after launch). Published website: /process.

title: Project pricing and timelines
content: Qordic Technologies does not publish fixed prices or guaranteed timelines on its website. Pricing depends on scope, delivery approach, support requirements, and workflow complexity. Timelines depend on the goals, work involved, and decision-making. The company discusses a tailored quote and realistic plan after understanding requirements. Do not promise prices or timelines. Published website: /faq.

title: Company values and ways of working
content: Qordic Technologies' published values include clear communication, business-first thinking, trust, and practical progress. Its website describes transparent updates, realistic expectations, security and accountability, and focused milestones. Do not invent company history, certifications, team details, clients, or achievements. Published website: /about.

title: How is project pricing determined?
content: Question: How is pricing determined? Answer: Pricing depends on scope, delivery approach, support requirements, and workflow complexity. Qordic Technologies discusses a tailored quote based on the challenge to solve; no fixed price is published. Source: /faq.

title: How long will a project take?
content: Question: How long will my project take? Answer: The timeline depends on goals, work involved, and how quickly decisions are made. Qordic Technologies outlines a realistic plan after understanding the requirements; no guaranteed timeline is published. Source: /faq.

title: How does Qordic approach security?
content: Question: How do you approach security? Answer: Security, access, data handling, and testing are considered based on the system and information involved. These questions should be part of the project conversation early on. Source: /faq.

title: What support is available after launch?
content: Question: What support is available after launch? Answer: Maintenance and ongoing support can be discussed as part of the engagement, with coverage and communication suited to the business. Confirm availability and terms with the team. Source: /faq.

title: Who owns code and project deliverables?
content: Question: Who owns the code and deliverables? Answer: Ownership and licensing terms should be clearly agreed in a project contract before work begins. Source: /faq.

title: How will project communication work?
content: Question: How will we communicate during the project? Answer: Channels, update rhythm, and points of contact are agreed during planning so everyone knows how decisions and progress are shared. Source: /faq.

title: Can I request project revisions?
content: Question: Can I request revisions or changes? Answer: Revisions are typically agreed within project scope. Additional work can be discussed if the project direction or requirements evolve. Source: /faq.

title: Can we sign an NDA?
content: Question: Can we sign an NDA? Answer: Share confidentiality requirements before discussing sensitive project details so an appropriate agreement can be reviewed. Source: /faq.

title: Contact Qordic Technologies
content: Visitors can contact Qordic Technologies through the website's Contact page and enquiry form to discuss what they are trying to improve, identify a relevant service, clarify scope, and discuss a quote. WhatsApp contact: https://wa.me/923462641229. The website notes that its enquiry form does not send details until a message service is connected. Published website: /contact.

title: Website privacy information
content: The published Privacy Policy says visitors may provide contact or project-enquiry details such as name, email, company, service interest, and project details. Such information may be used to respond, understand proposed work, arrange a consultation, and maintain related business communications. The page does not claim unconfirmed cookie or analytics practices. Published website: /privacy.

title: Website terms and project commitments
content: The published Terms & Conditions state that website information is general and does not create a contractual commitment. Project scope, pricing, timelines, ownership, and support obligations should be documented in a signed agreement or proposal. Published website: /terms.
